exposure: Hospital (Airlangga University Hospital vs. dr. M. Soewandhie General Hospital)
outcome: Contribution of Robson groups to CS rate
cohort: The study included patients with hypertension in pregnancy who delivered at Airlangga University Hospital and dr. M. Soewandhie General Hospital Surabaya during 2023.
finding: No significant variance in the overall caesarean section rate for deliveries with hypertension in pregnancy was observed between the two hospitals.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was identified as the predominant reason for caesarean delivery at both hospitals, while the highest contributing Robson groups varied between hospitals.
